title: The Temple, part two: every texture, pattern, motif, shape and icon, and the membership night band
detail: Follows LIVE-1285. Ships the 19 remaining textures, patterns, motifs and blobs and the 10 line icons from the Royal Temple design system (metadata stripped), their --tp-* tokens, the tp-* utility classes (texture layers, edge bands, watermark motifs, blobs, mask icons) and the membership section as the design's night band with arch-soft rung cards, the middle rung lifted. Still open and needing data work, not skin work: the hero fact row and the event date stamp (the house hero and offering models carry no facts or dates), the signed-in member menu with first name (the membership endpoint returns only the tier name), the Your house account page, the RSVP island and the week-strip arches.
